policies.name: business_locations_manager_write
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM business_members bm
  WHERE ((bm.business_id = business_locations.business_id) AND (bm.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (bm.is_active = true) AND (bm.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text])))))
policies.check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM business_members bm
  WHERE ((bm.business_id = business_locations.business_id) AND (bm.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (bm.is_active = true) AND (bm.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text])))))

policies.name: branch_role_write
policies.qual:
(tenh_branch_setting_visible(business_id, location_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM business_members
  WHERE ((business_members.business_id = branch_role_permissions.business_id) AND (business_members.user_id = auth.uid()) AND business_members.is_active AND (business_members.role = 'owner'::text)))))
policies.check:
(tenh_branch_setting_visible(business_id, location_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM business_members
  WHERE ((business_members.business_id = branch_role_permissions.business_id) AND (business_members.user_id = auth.uid()) AND business_members.is_active AND (business_members.role = 'owner'::text)))))
